tasks.title: Tier 1: Lock-free SPSC Outbox + App wiring
tasks.description: Outbox class (21 tests), App integration (19 tests), enqueue helpers, drain processing with webview_eval and lua::dispatchViewLifecycleEvent. Done in commits f4a5af3, 60b7939, a9ad022.

tasks.title: Tier 2: CFRunLoopSource auto-drain
tasks.description: dispatch::init() registers CFRunLoopSource on main run loop. dispatch::shutdown() removes it. Wired in main.cpp. Done in b3b92ee.

tasks.title: Tier 3: Off-thread producers (file watcher, IPC)
tasks.description: Enable file watcher / IPC threads to push into Outbox. Needs App lifetime safety during teardown.

tasks.title: Tier 4: Lua coroutines → dispatch queue
tasks.description: ctx:emit() should use dispatch::evalJS() instead of webview_eval() directly. Bridge refactor needed.

tasks.title: Tier 5: Worker thread pool for heavy commands
tasks.description: Offload CPU-intensive commands (bundling, linting) to a background thread pool. Each worker needs its own lua_State or serializes via JSON.

tasks.title: Windows platform branch (remote agent #2)
tasks.description: Remote agent coconut-milk#2 created branch 'platform-windows' with ADR-0002. Worktree at ../coconut-milk-win. Research complete, plan done. Awaiting implementation start.

tasks.title: Linux platform branch (remote agent #3)
tasks.description: Remote agent coconut-milk#3 researching Lima for Linux testing. User approved full steam ahead: branch 'platform-linux', ADR-0003, and implement all GTK3 stubs.

tasks.title: Event model refactor (Lua event object)
tasks.description: Plans/event-model-refactor.md: Stage 2-5. Replace old (name,payload,ctx) triple with event object. coconut.on(), view:on(), _dispatch chain. JS-side CoconutEvent class.

tasks.title: v0.1.0 Scope Analysis & Confirmation
tasks.description: Analyze specs, existing code, and todos to define v0.1.0 vs v0.2.0 boundary. Present plan for user confirmation.

tasks.title: v0.1.0 Scope: Define and activate
tasks.description: Scope v0.1.0 created with features: ctx:rebind, coconut.hotreload(), hmr.auto_regenerate, no threads. Single-window, cross-platform.

tasks.title: ctx:rebind() for command overwriting
tasks.description: Added rebind() to CoconutContext that overwrites existing handler instead of throwing on duplicate. Registered in Lua usertype as ctx:rebind().

tasks.title: coconut.hotreload() manual command reload
tasks.description: Manual HMR trigger. Scans commands/ for file changes, clears package.loaded[module], re-runs .g.lua, rebinds commands. No background thread (v0.1.0). Config flag hmr.auto_regenerate for running generator before reload.

tasks.title: v0.2.0: Background file watcher for auto-HMR
tasks.description: Background thread polls commands/ for changes, pushes through dispatch queue. Needs App lifetime safety. Deferred from v0.1.0.
